title: A function changed by one line
assertion: Only that function's file changes, by that line and its body-hash line, the hash of the body alone (between the dollar quotes, or the SQL-standard body) equal to Appendix C's for a plpgsql and a SQL-standard body; a grant added or given by another grantor, SECURITY DEFINER flipped, `SET search_path` removed or a calling policy added each changes the file; a procedure and a BEGIN ATOMIC body render as the catalog holds them
noFileReason: A probe migration changes a function on a scratch database; no file.
